Purpose: Hold as much runoff as possible in the upper and middle catchment
Soft measures: Catchment treatment; revival of tank cascades and community water bodies; protection of tank foreshores and flood plains; groundwater recharge
Hard measures: Deepening and capacity restoration of tanks and reservoirs; new reservoirs and conversion of tanks to reservoirs; riverine (instream) reservoirs, check dams and anicuts; reuse of abandoned quarries

Purpose: Delay and flatten the flood peak before it reaches the city
Soft measures: groundwater recharge Pre-emptying of part of the storage ahead of forecast heavy rain; operation of reservoirs on forecasts; revised freeboard standards using post-2015 flood levels
Hard measures: of abandoned quarries Conversion of surplus weirs to gated flood regulators; strengthening of tank bunds; remodelling of check dams into barrages; diversion of flood water to adjoining basins

Stage: 3. Flood protection and river training (controlled discharge)
Purpose: Pass the remaining flood safely to the sea
Soft measures: Flood-prone area zoning; eviction of encroachments in waterways; ecorestoration of river banks and estuaries
Hard measures: Resectioning and widening of rivers and channels; flood protection walls; restoration of missing links (open channel or cut-and-cover); remodelling of bridges and bottleneck structures; sustainable opening of river mouths
